question: 월별 신규 고객 순매출을 보여줘
baseline_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', users.created_at), SUM(payments.amount) FROM users JOIN payments ON users.user_id = payments.user_id GROUP BY 1
system_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', users.first_paid_at), SUM(payments.amount - payments.refund_amount - payments.discount_amount) FROM users JOIN payments ON users.user_id = payments.user_id WHERE payments.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY 1
